_comment: CDK owns this child-stack override because conventional CDK source lives in lib/ and bin/. Inheriting TypeScript's src-only mutate list makes the mutation gate inert in a CDK repository with no src/ directory. src remains eligible for hybrid repositories.
_concurrencyComment: Stryker calibrates each mutant's budget in one serial dry-run process, then spends it in the concurrent mutant phase. Lisa's matched-mutant control measured 53 timeouts in a 102-mutant range at 17 workers; the same range at 4 workers produced zero timeouts and revealed that 41 of those clock-based kills were real survivors. Four is the measured correctness calibration, not a throughput guess.
_timeoutsComment: Both budgets below are liveness bounds chosen explicitly so a slow or busy machine is not misreported as a weak mutation score.
_timeoutMSComment: timeoutMS adds one minute beyond each mutant's measured test runtime. It is a liveness bound for a wedged mutant, not a performance target.
_dryRunTimeoutMinutesComment: dryRunTimeoutMinutes gives the unmutated suite twenty minutes to finish before the gate reports that no mutation score was produced.
_thresholdsOwner: Owned by .lisa.config.json quality.mutation.strykerThresholds. Every other key in this file is Stryker's own and is yours to edit; thresholds is not — lisa sync writes it from that config key. Change the config, not this line.
